about: Scene file test vectors (docs/adr/0031 amendments 2 and 4): each case changes one thing from a valid scene. 'expect' is 'ok', or the keyword the error message starts with. Read by Teleop.RobotArm.Tests (SceneDocumentTests) and robot/isaac/tests (test_scene.py); both readers must agree.
